name: Rclone Sync & Monitor
author: susamn
description: Universal Rclone visualizer: active sync processes, timers & 24h schedule timeline, remote storage gauges, and FUSE mounts.

barWidget.description: Monitor rclone sync jobs, timers, remote storage, and mounts.

schema.label: Storage quota refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often `rclone about` is called per remote to refresh storage quota. This hits the provider API, so it is cached between status polls; the Refresh button always forces a fresh read.

schema.label: Closed refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often rclone status is polled while the popup panel is closed.

schema.label: Open refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often rclone status is polled while the popup panel is open.
